pullRequests.title: Match 298 US and 24 PAL functions, mostly shape twins of matched code
pullRequests.author: farfeduc
pullRequests.head: decomp/shape-twins
pullRequests.body:
Matches 298 US functions and 24 PAL functions. US goes from 7,673 to 7,967 functions (12.88% → 14.18% of the code), PAL from 8,044 to 8,103 (14.62% → 14.89%).
How
Most are shape twins: functions whose instructions are those of a function already matched in C, with other constants and addresses (OpenRAC's tools/mips.py shape fingerprint over the US and PAL catalogues). For each one, the twin's C was copied and then:

every constant that differs was set to retail's (from the compiled diff),…

pullRequests.title: Port 105 functions matched in rac3-decomp (same code in both games)
pullRequests.author: farfeduc
pullRequests.head: decomp/cross-game-ports
pullRequests.body:
Ports 105 functions that rac3-decomp has already matched in C. They are the same code in both games: same instructions, only the addresses differ. US goes from 7,673 to 7,777 functions (12.88% → 13.22% of the code), and PAL from 8,044 to 8,147, since the same C builds the PAL bytes too.
How the pairs were found
OpenRAC's tools/xmap.py (scan, then ports rac3/ntsc rac4/ntsc) compares the code of both discs function by function and lists the rac3 functions the project has matched that rac4 has as…
